entries.reference: My name is Ava. I am a student in an English group. This is my notebook. It has a short note. I write my name in it. I have a textbook too. Please open your book, Tom. We can read one name together. A sound is not clear? Please ask me. I can speak again and help you spell it. Then we can check our work with the teacher. Thank you for your help.

My name is Nia. On class days, I wake at five. I get up and make my bed. I wash my face. Today I put on a blue shirt and my shoes. The sun is out, so I put a hat on my head. I start class at ten. I eat lunch at one. After class, I stay for five minutes to check a note. Then I take a slow walk. I eat dinner at six. Before dinner, I write a note for tomorrow.
